svg.title: Voider network, integrity, display and USB pairing
svg.desc: Original architecture overview preserved; role-separated mailboxes and the two lower explanatory rows updated. The retained artwork is embedded; revised labels and boxes are editable vectors.
svg.text: CAP2 · separate mailboxes by role + slot
SFTP over Tor · separate account, key path and chroot
CLIENT: vmcNNN
SERVER: vmsNNN
/var/sftp/clients/vmbNNN
/var/sftp/servers/vmbNNN
Incoming CAP2 uses client mailboxes; server accounts have no key.
Peer writes in: OFFER → reads out: ANSWER → writes in: READY
Same XID · authenticated atomic records · RAM only · size/count/TTL limits
Automatic: BOOT + SYSTEM must match recorded hashes.
You compare STATE with your trusted record. Both must pass.
1 / Automatic device check
On every boot, verify BOOT + SYSTEM.
Hash both complete raw partitions;
check layout, manifest and combined hash.
Keep OS read-only; load STATE into RAM.
Failure blocks normal operation.
2 / Your STATE check
On the display, compare the fingerprint
with your separate trusted record.
It covers manifest + saved STATE archive.
Confirm the current matching fingerprint.
Both checks pass → normal operation.
Display / review and confirm
Required on both appliances: PiTFT 2.2″
Adafruit HAT 2315 · 320 × 240 pixels
Four buttons · no touch input
Shows check results; you confirm here.
Then: contacts, transport and settings.
1 / Export → private USB handoff
Export a client slot as a pairing bundle.
It supplies the remote peer index s,
WG / SFTP keys and the pair Tor secret.
Carry this bundle privately to the peer.
A checksum detects a changed copy;
it does not prove who supplied it.
2 / Validate → import server
Read USB into private RAM; validate
archive, paths, manifest, roles and keys.
Recheck fingerprint; reject changed data.
Import chooses a local server slot X.
Keep remote s from the bundle:
X and s are independent indexes.
3 / Save STATE → activate
Save the validated relationship in STATE
before admitting the new peer.
Tor HMAC binds pair secret + fingerprint.
Record the new STATE check code outside
the appliance for later boot checks.
This authorized change keeps boot active.
